Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited (347-47.0 tff *11 31TFIT) DFCCIL, Corporate Office Complex, Sector - 145, Noida, Uttar Pradesh - 201306 VACANCY NOTICE NO. 35/2026 NO. HQ-HRODPOU(DEP)/28/2026/44727 Date: 13.08.2026 GENERAL MANAGERS, ALL ZONAL RAILWAYS/PRODUCTION UNITS DIRECTOR GENERALS/DIRECTORS ALL RAILWAY TRAINING INSTITUTES Sub: Vacancy Notice for the post of JGM (IT) at Corporate Office, DFCCIL on Deputation basis. ORGANIZATION : DFCCIL TITLE & NO. OF POSTS : JGM (IT)- 01 Post LOCATION : Corporate Office DURATION : 3 years extendable to 5 years (subject to exemption by DPE from the rule of immediate absorption) SERVICE : Minimum 12 of total post-qualification executive experience in IT/Telecom/Electronics/Computer/IS field in a Central/ State Government / PSU organization TERM OF APPOINTMENT : Deputation AGE . Not more than 55 years SCALE OF PAY : Parent pay plus deputation allowance (And all other Perks and Allowances applicable as per DFCCIL policy). SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS : JGM: Central/State Govt. officers working in analogous substantive grade (Level-13) in the relevant discipline or in Junior Administrative Grade (JAG) (Level-12) with 8-12 years' service in Group A in the relevant discipline or PSU employees working in analogous grade in relevant discipline or in Rs. 80000-220000 (IDA) (E5) with four years' service in the grade. ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATION : Educational: B.E. / B. Tech in Computer Science / Information Technology / Electronics / Electrical Engineering OR M.C.A. (Master of Computer Applications) OR equivalent from a recognized University/Institution. Domain Expertise: Proven in-depth experience in one or more core IT functions: Networking (LAN/WAN) design/management, Application Development (Software Development Lifecycle), or Cloud/Hybrid Hosting management. /---) Corporate Office: DFCCIL, Corporate Office Complex, Sector-145, Noida, Uttar Pradesh - 201306 Registered Office: 233, 2"d Floor, Tower-E, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi-110029 Tel.: +91-11-23454700, Fax: 011-23454701, Web: www.dfccil.com CIN: U60232 DL 2006 GO! 155068 -2 — Familiarity: Experience in handling public procurement procedures, including tenders and transactions on the GeM portal. DESIRABLE QUALIFICATION : Educational: Master's degree or professional certifications (e.g., CCNA/CCNP, Certified Cloud Practitioner, Certified Scrum Master, CISA, ISO 27001). Domain Ex.ertise: Working knowledge of SAP modules and user support processes. Exposure to Cyber Security operations and incident response procedures. Project Management: Experience in managing medium-to-large- scale IT projects, ensuring timely delivery and budget adherence. JOB DESCRIPTION : Technical Operations: Manage and optimize the entire DFCCIL Network Infrastructure (LAN/WAN), ensuring high availability, performance, and security across all sites. Application Development: Oversee the full lifecycle of Application Development and maintenance, including new system development, integration and enhancement of existing platforms. Knowledge of Enterprise ERP like SAP. Hosting & Cloud Infra: Manage the day-to-day operations of the On-premise Data Centre and Cloud Hosting services, including capacity planning, backup, and disaster recovery. Coordination & Compliance: Coordinate with internal stakeholders, Ministry of Railways, and vendors for IT projects. Ensure compliance with Government guidelines and data security standards. Procurement Support: Assist the AGM in the planning, specification, and execution of the IT procurement process, with direct involvement in GeM procedures and contract management. Team Supervision: Supervise and guide the functional teams responsible for network, application, hosting, and first-level security operations. NOTE : Cut-off date for age and eligibility would be reckoned as on closing date of vacancy notice. WEB ADDRESS : http://dfccil,gov.in/dfccil app/Careers CLOSING DATE : 30 DAYS FROM DATE OF ISSUE INSTRUCTIONS: Willing and eligible employees may send their applications in the enclosed proforma through proper channel along with NOC, attested APARs ratings for the last five years (For proper appreciation of APARs, the organization should forward their guidelines for rating criteria), Corporate Office: DFCCIL, Corporate Office Complex, Sector-145, Noida, Uttar Pradesh - 201306 Registered Office: 233, 2"d Floor, Tower-E, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi-110029 Tel.: +91-11-23454700, Fax: 011-23454701, Web: www.dfccil.com CIN: U60232 DL 2006 GOI 155068 VIGILANCE/D&AR clearance to GENERAL MANAGER (HR), DFCCIL Corporate Office Complex, Sector-145, Noida, Uttar Pradesh — 201306. No. R&P/305/2024 दिल्‍ली दिश्‍िदिद्यालय UNIVERSITY OF DELHI Page 1 of 1 Scheme of Examination for Screening and or Shortlisting of applicants for Interview applicable for the post code: TDFT01, TDFT02, TDFT03 (Final Selection will be based on Interview/Personal Interaction) A. Scheme of the Examination: Written Test Paper MCQ Type Time: 2 hours* Max. marks: 400 marks (100 questions) Total Marks 400 marks *45 minutes extra would be given to Visually Handicapped, Cerebral Palsy candidates or similarly placed candidates from PwBD category. B. Test components: Subject specific questions as per syllabus of Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) as detailed below: Sr. No. Discipline Test Component 1. Computer Engineering (Post Code: TDFT01) As per syllabus prescribed for GATE paper for Computer Science and Information Technology (Copy enclosed) 2. Electrical Engineering (Post Code: TDFT02) As per syllabus prescribed for GATE paper for Electrical Engineering (Copy enclosed) 3. Electronics and Communication Engineering (Post Code: TDFT03) As per syllabus prescribed for GATE paper for Electronics and Communication Engineering (Copy enclosed) Note: 1. All the questions shall be compulsory. Each question carries 04 marks. There shall be negative marking of 01 mark for each wrong answer. The cutoff for qualifying the written test will be 50% marks of the average score of the top 05% of the candidates. There will be a relaxation of 05% marks for candidates belonging to SC, ST and 10% for PwBD category. 2. If the number of candidates qualifying the written test is more, then 30 candidates for the first vacancy and 10 candidates for every additional vacancy, in each category, shall be called for interview in order of their ranks in the merit list prepared on the basis of result of the written test. All candidates having same marks as per the cut off shall be called for the interview. 3. The marks awarded to the candidates in the written test shall not have any weightage/credit or merit during assessment/interview of the candidates by the Selection Committee as these marks shall be used only for screening/shortlisting purposes.
